english.title: Occupier fail to ensure domestic pig isolated from feral pig following classical/African swine fever
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the occupier of premises containing domestic pigs, that were in a feral pig

(A)_[investigation]_
(B)_[control]_

zone namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), failed, following confirmation of

(C)_[classical]_
(D)_[African]_

swine fever in a feral pig, to ensure that all pigs on the premises were kept in a place on the premises where they were isolated from feral pigs
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 2(a) of Schedule 2 to and regulation 39(1)(q) and (2) of the Diseases of Swine Regulations 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the occupier of premises containing domestic pigs
that were in a feral pig investigation or control zone
failed, following confirmation of classical or African swine fever in a feral pig
to ensure that all pigs on the premises
were kept in a place on the premises where they were isolated from feral pigs

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time Limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
